transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

Well, I guess what brings me in is... I just don't have the push I used to have. I used to be involved in things, you know, like choir, and my quilting, or going out to visit folks. But lately, most days I just sit at home. I keep the TV on low and just sit there, even though I know people are expecting me to show up. I just don't have it in me right now.
Have you been feeling down or depressed?

No, I don't think so. I mean... I'm not crying or feeling sad or anything like that. It's not like I'm down in the dumps. I just... well, I just don't have the drive anymore. I don't really feel bad in my mood, I just sit there.
Do you still enjoy things like choir, quilting, or visiting people when you actually do them?

I'm not rightly sure. I guess... well, I haven't really been doing them to find out. I just haven't had the urge to pick up my quilting or go see anybody, so I couldn't really tell you if I'd still enjoy it or not.
How long have you been feeling this lack of drive?
Well, I suppose... it's been building up for a while now. Ever since I retired from the school office, which was a little over two years ago. It just sort of started then and kept going.
Did this change start after your retirement?

Yes, that's right. Right after I finished up at the school. Once I didn't have to go in to work anymore... well, that's when I really started noticing I just didn't want to do much of anything else either.
Does your lack of drive feel mainly like a reaction to retiring?

I don't rightly know if I'd call it a reaction. I mean... I wasn't sad or upset about leaving the job or anything like that. It was just time. It's more like... well, once I stopped having to go in, my get-up-and-go just sort of went with it. I couldn't really tell you why.
For most of the past two years, have you felt down or low in yourself?

No, I can't really say that I have. I don't feel sad or... low in my spirits, no. I'm not sitting around crying or feeling bad about myself. It's really just what I said before—I just don't have the urge to do much of anything. But my mood itself... well, it's mostly been fine.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot about things, even when there isn’t a clear reason to?
No, I don't think so. I'm not really a worrier. I mean, I don't sit around fretting about things, if that's what you mean. There's not much to worry about anyway.
During this time, have you felt hopeless?

No, not at all. I haven't felt hopeless. I mean... I don't feel like things are bad or anything like that. I'm just taking it day by day, even if I'm not doing much of anything. So no, no hopeless feelings.
When you do make yourself do something you used to enjoy, do you still get pleasure from it?
Well... I guess I'm not really sure. I haven't really tried to do much of anything lately, to be honest. So I don't know if I'd enjoy it or not. I just haven't had the energy or the mind to even try.
Over the past two years, have there been stretches of at least two weeks when you felt sad, empty, or depressed most of the day nearly every day?

No, I haven't had anything like that. I don't really get sad or depressed. I mean, I know I just told you I don't do much these days, but it's not because I'm sitting around crying or feeling down. So... no, I haven't had any stretches like that.
Do you feel tired or low on energy most days?

No, I wouldn't say I feel tired. It's not like I need to sleep all day or anything. Like I said, I just don't have the mind to do much, but it's not because I'm physically tired or out of energy. I just... sit there mostly.
During this time, have you often felt unhappy or blue, even if not intensely sad?

No, not really. I don't feel blue or unhappy. I know it probably sounds strange since I just sit around so much, but... no, it's not a sad feeling at all. I just feel kind of blank, I guess. But definitely not blue.
When you actually do something you used to enjoy, do you still enjoy it?

I don't really know. Like I said, I don't do much of anything these days, so... I haven't really noticed. If I do happen to do something, it's just fine, I guess. I don't really think about whether I'm enjoying it or not.
Before these past two years, was there ever a time in your life when you had at least two weeks of feeling depressed most of the day nearly every day?
No, I don't think so. I can't remember ever feeling like that. I've had normal days and bad days like anyone else, but... no, never two straight weeks of feeling depressed or anything.
Do you feel little interest or pleasure in almost all activities most days?

Well, no, I wouldn't say that. Like I mentioned before, I know I don't do a whole lot right now, but... it's not like I have zero interest in things. I just kind of keep to myself and sit quietly. I don't think I've lost all my pleasure in everything, I just... I'm just not doing much lately to really notice. So no, I don't think I feel that way.
Has this change led you to stop doing important day-to-day responsibilities?

Yes, I suppose it has. I've had to step back from leading the choir... and I stopped helping with the projects down at the senior center. I just wasn't keeping up with what I promised folks I'd do, so I let those go. Because of it, my friends from church actually check on me a lot more than they used to.
Has this change been upsetting or distressing to you?
Well, no, not really. I don't feel upset by it. I know I'm not doing as much as I used to, but... it doesn't really bother me. I'm fine just being quiet at home, so I wouldn't say it's distressing.
Has this change made it hard for you to keep up with your usual roles or commitments?

Well, like I was just saying a minute ago... yes. That's what happened with the choir and the senior center projects. I couldn't keep up with the things I promised folks I'd do, so I had to step back from those roles. And like I mentioned, now my friends from church are checking in on me a lot more than they used to because of it.
During these past two years, have you felt depressed or down most days?
No, not really. I don't feel sad or... depressed. Like I was saying before, I'm just fine being quiet at home. So, no, I wouldn't say I've been feeling down most days.
